exception_time_pair_check.name: exception_time_pair_check
exception_time_pair_check.value: ("availability_exceptions"."start_minute" IS NULL AND "availability_exceptions"."end_minute" IS NULL) OR ("availability_exceptions"."start_minute" >= 0 AND "availability_exceptions"."start_minute" < "availability_exceptions"."end_minute" AND "availability_exceptions"."end_minute" <= 1440)

exception_scope_check.name: exception_scope_check
exception_scope_check.value: ("availability_exceptions"."location_id" IS NOT NULL OR "availability_exceptions"."professional_user_id" IS NOT NULL) AND (("availability_exceptions"."professional_user_id" IS NULL AND "availability_exceptions"."practice_profession_id" IS NULL) OR ("availability_exceptions"."professional_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_exceptions"."practice_profession_id" IS NOT NULL))

exception_extra_hours_range_check.name: exception_extra_hours_range_check
exception_extra_hours_range_check.value: "availability_exceptions"."kind" <> 'extra_hours' OR ("availability_exceptions"."start_minute" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_exceptions"."end_minute" IS NOT NULL)

availability_scope_refs_check.name: availability_scope_refs_check
availability_scope_refs_check.value: ("availability_rules"."scope" = 'practice' AND "availability_rules"."location_id" IS NULL AND "availability_rules"."professional_user_id" IS NULL AND "availability_rules"."practice_profession_id" IS NULL) OR ("availability_rules"."scope" = 'location' AND "availability_rules"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_rules"."professional_user_id" IS NULL AND "availability_rules"."practice_profession_id" IS NULL) OR ("availability_rules"."scope" = 'professional' AND "availability_rules"."location_id" IS NULL AND "availability_rules"."professional_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_rules"."practice_profession_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("availability_rules"."scope" = 'professional_location' AND "availability_rules"."location_id" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_rules"."professional_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "availability_rules"."practice_profession_id" IS NOT NULL)

appointments_cancel_metadata_check.name: appointments_cancel_metadata_check
appointments_cancel_metadata_check.value: ("appointments"."status" = 'cancelled' AND "appointments"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("appointments"."status" <> 'cancelled' AND "appointments"."cancelled_at" IS NULL)

clients_contact_required_check.name: clients_contact_required_check
clients_contact_required_check.value: "clients"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "clients"."phone" IS NOT NULL
